text: 随着深交所正式将债券ETF纳入质押式协议回购交易质押券范围，科创债ETF嘉实当日成功完成深交所首笔债券ETF质押式协议回购交易，标志着深市债券ETF质押融资功能正式落地，为机构盘活存量资产提供了新路径。（中国基金报）
text_en: As the Shenzhen Stock Exchange officially included bond ETFs in the scope of collateral for pledged agreement repos, Jiashi SSE Science and Technology Innovation Board Bond ETF successfully completed the first bond ETF pledged agreement repo transaction on the SZSE that day, marking the official launch of the pledge financing function for SZSE bond ETFs and providing institutions with a new path to revitalize existing assets. (China Fund News)
